tone.target: Driving indie rock crunch with bright shimmer
tone.profile: Driving indie rock crunch with bright shimmer
tone.summary: A blend of light overdrive (Green OD) into a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) for tight strumming, enhanced by Chorus and Room reverb to achieve the desired shimmering indie sound.
